newsitem.title: ITALY: Ambroveneto suspended limit up in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Ambroveneto suspended limit up in Milan.

text.p: Trading in shares in Banco Ambrosiano Veneto (Ambroveneto) was suspended on the Milan bourse on Tuesday after going limit up for the second consecutive day.
Trading was halted when Ambroveneto stock was quoted at 8,090 lire against a 7,361 lire close on Monday after earlier peaking a year's high of 7,375.
"Everyone's buying Ambroveneto and there's a lot of foreign interest," one dealer said. The stock is some 90 percent higher than at the start of the year.
Ambroveneto is planning a merger with Milan-based savings bank Cariplo and the market in many Italian banking shares has been boosted by talk of takeovers and restructuring.
